title: The universal Askey-Wilson algebra maps onto the polynomial algebra in three variables
author: Paul Terwilliger
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the universal Askey-Wilson algebra admits a unique F-algebra homomorphism onto the polynomial algebra in three variables taking A, B, C to the three generators, and that this homomorphism is surjective (statement lines 2663-2681). The proof observes that in the commutative target the three elements obtained from A-bar, B-bar, C-bar by adding the q-commutator correction are central, and that these centrality statements are exactly the defining relations of the algebra (proof lines 2684-2713); existence follows, while uniqueness and surjectivity are read off from the fact that the source is generated by A, B, C and the target by their images (proof lines 2714-2731). The content is concentrated in the first step, where the centrality of a specific corrected triple has to be seen to match the defining relations of the algebra; the remaining two clauses are one sentence each. H2.
